method: Original route1 renderer; shared Chrome :9522; isolated CDP context; requestAnimationFrame samples (page clock slowed 8x after load, so ms is spring time at ~4 ms per frame; reduced-motion runs at real time) of the main surface rect, the first Recents row rect and the sidebar content's computed opacity/transform. ms is page time since the sampler started; the click lands a few ms after sample 0. Align on the first moving frame.
js: app-initial-6350d04672d0.js QRt: animate(progress, 0|1, {type:'spring', duration:.3, bounce:.1}) = motion findSpring (zeta .9, omega 28.27 rad/s), done at 300 ms; main x/width linear in progress; sidebar content opacity = progress, translateX = -16px * (1 - progress); content unmounted while progress is 0; instant under reduced motion (ms atom).
